items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: if you read that recent bio that Robin Kelley wrote.

ctx.x: “Bud On Bach.” Yeah, exactly. Bud was a deep guy. The lesson to be... One of the lessons I learned about Bud, through Bud, was a non-musical lesson, which was the real horrific effects of psycho-surgery and psychiatry on certain jazz musicians. And drugs. That’s what took Thelonious Monk out, too, if you read that recent bio that Robin Kelley wrote.
It was a big hazard among a lot of musicians at the time you were coming up.
